reels.title: SemanTok: Predictable Semantic Tokens for Efficient Autoregressive Video Generation

editorial_notes.reasoning: Fits the core 'multimodal_diffusion' mandate; introduces a high-quality visualization opportunity comparing 'cluttered' vs 'tokenized' video streaming to show why some models feel laggy while others are fluid.
editorial_notes.recommended_hook: Why does your AI video generator struggle to keep track of a moving object?
editorial_notes.suggested_everyday_analogy: A library archive: comparing searching through a pile of loose, disorganized papers versus a perfectly indexed card catalog.
